The Unifilter-96 GF/C filter plates were soaked with 50 of 0.3% PEI per well for at least 0.5 hour at room temperature.When the binding assays were complete, the reaction mixture was filtered through GF/C plates using Perkin Elmer Filtermate Harvester, and then each plate was washed 4 times with cold wash buffer. The filter plates were dried for 1 hour at 50 degrees. After drying, the bottom of the filter plate wells were sealed using Perkin Elmer Unifilter-96 backing seal tape. 50 μl of Perkin Elmer Microscint 20 cocktail was added. The top of the filter plates were sealed with Perkin Elmer TopSeal-A sealing film.
